title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. Under the scheme, income support of Rs. 6000/- per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2000/- each every four months is provided to all landholding farmer families across the country.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families who have cultivable landholding in their names.
Small and marginal farmers as well as other landholders.

Exclusions: Institutional landholders, farmer families holding constitutional posts, serving/retired government officers, professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs), and persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year.
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6,000 per year paid directly into bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in 3 equal installments of Rs. 2,000.
required_documents: Savings Bank Account details (linked to Aadhaar)
how_to_apply: Farmers can self-register online at pmkisan.gov.in under 'Farmer Corner' -> 'New Farmer Registration', or through Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Agriculture Nodal Officers.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance & Ministry of Agriculture
description: The Kisan Credit Card scheme aims at providing adequate and timely credit support from the banking system under a single window with flexible and simplified procedure to the farmers for their cultivation and other agricultural needs including post-harvest and livestock maintenance.
eligibility: Individual / joint borrowers who are owner cultivators.
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers.
Farmers engaged in animal husbandry, dairy, poultry, and fisheries.
benefits: Short-term crop loans up to Rs. 3 Lakhs at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (with 2% interest subvention and 3% prompt repayment incentive). Simple revolving credit card facility valid for 5 years.
required_documents: Land title documents, passbook or tenant agreement
how_to_apply: Apply at any Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank branch, or apply online through the bank's portal or JanSamarth portal.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PMFBY provides comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising out of unforeseen non-preventable natural risks such as drought, flood, pests, and disease.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas during the season who have an insurable interest.
Voluntary for all farmers (both loanee and non-loanee farmers).
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance for standing crops, prevented sowing, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities. Uniform premium of only 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; the rest is subsidized by the government.
how_to_apply: Enroll through National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), through the nearest bank branch, Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS), or CSC centre before the cut-off date.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: The Soil Health Card scheme assesses the nutrient status of farmer's fields and issues periodic Soil Health Cards containing crop-wise recommendations of dosage of nutrients and fertilizers required to improve soil fertility and farm productivity.
eligibility: All agricultural landholders and farmers across all States and Union Territories in India.
benefits: Free soil test report detailing status of 12 parameters: Macro-nutrients (N, P, K), Secondary nutrients (S), Micro-nutrients (Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo), and Physical parameters (pH, EC, Organic Carbon). Includes customized fertilizer and bio-fertilizer recommendations.
required_documents: Soil sample collected following standard agricultural guidelines
how_to_apply: Local Agriculture Extension Officers / Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVK) collect samples from the farm. Farmers can track their card status at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: A medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets through interest subvention and financial support.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Marketing Cooperative Societies, Farmer Producers Organizations (FPOs), SHGs, Joint Liability Groups, Agri-entrepreneurs, and Start-ups.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 2 Crore with interest subvention of 3% per annum for up to 7 years. Credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE for loans up to Rs. 2 Crore.
required_documents: Land record or lease agreement for minimum period of project life
Registration certificate / KYC documents of borrowing entity
Bank account statements and audited financial reports
how_to_apply: Online application via the dedicated AIF portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in) with project DPR.

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Aims to enhance water use efficiency at farm level through micro-irrigation systems such as drip and sprinkler irrigation technologies, expanding cultivable area under assured irrigation.
eligibility: All categories of farmers having cultivable land with an assured water source.
Members of water users associations or cooperative societies.
benefits: Subsidy of up to 55% for Small and Marginal farmers, and up to 45% for other farmers for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems.
required_documents: Water source proof (Borewell / Open well / Canal connectivity)
how_to_apply: Applications are submitted through the respective State Horticulture or Agriculture Department portal or District Horticulture Office.
